title: Coalesce test-run compaction completion transport projection work
outcome: A burst of completed test-run compactions reuses one final aggregate transport cut instead of capturing and materializing complete run history once per completed row, while preserving existing persistence, canonical identities, revisions and evidence retention.
acceptance: Controlled multi-completion coverage demonstrates that aggregate capture/materialization work is coalesced while public revision admission and final counters remain correct.
Existing compaction persistence and evidence-retention behavior remains unchanged; diagnostics distinguish measured projection work from live timing.
